app.title: Velarum
app.tagline: Forge your civilization and watch the city grow.

auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

hud.protectedTip: Amount protected from raids. Anything above it can be looted.

build.title: Build
build.editHint: Edit mode: click a building then an empty cell to move it.
build.selectHint: Select a building to see its details.
build.queueFull: queues full — wait for a build to finish

buildingDesc.lar_do_cla: Heart of the clan: sustains your people and is the foundation of the whole village.
buildingDesc.viveiro_de_pedra: Extracts Matter, the raw resource for building and recruiting.
buildingDesc.fogueira_comunal: Produces Energy, which powers works, rituals and the village's growth.
buildingDesc.pedra_da_memoria: Generates Knowledge, saved for advanced structures and (soon) research.
buildingDesc.celeiro_de_argila: Sets the share of resources protected from raids (🔒). Anything above it can be looted.
buildingDesc.canteiro_de_almas: Lets you recruit troops and sets which units you can train.
buildingDesc.torre_do_vigia: Strengthens defense: adds attack power to your garrison, wounding those who assault the city.
buildingDesc.muralha: Strengthens defense: adds hit points that soak the raider's blow and spare your troops.
buildingDesc.toca_dos_batedores: Enables espionage: trains and sends scouts (a non-combat unit) on missions that reveal a target's intel — troops, defenses and resources.

buildingLore.lar_do_cla: It was around this fire that the first clan gathered. While it burns, the people have a home.
buildingLore.viveiro_de_pedra: Where others see dead rock, the Velari hear the stone breathe and yield its substance.
buildingLore.fogueira_comunal: A flame that never dies — from it springs the warmth that moves the whole village.
buildingLore.pedra_da_memoria: Every groove holds a memory of the clan. To touch it is to hear the ancestors.
buildingLore.celeiro_de_argila: Jars sealed beneath the earth: what is stored deep, the raider cannot take.
buildingLore.canteiro_de_almas: Here the souls willing to fight are shaped into warriors of the clan.
buildingLore.torre_do_vigia: From up high, eyes that never sleep wound any who dare cross the gates.
buildingLore.muralha: Stone upon stone, the border between the clan and the chaos beyond.
buildingLore.toca_dos_batedores: Hidden burrows at the treeline, from which silent eyes set out to read the enemy.

buildingUpgrade.lar_do_cla: Each level unlocks new buildings and more advanced structures.
buildingUpgrade.celeiro_de_argila: Each level raises the protected share (lv1 500, lv2 850, lv3 1300…).
buildingUpgrade.canteiro_de_almas: Each level unlocks new units (Archer at level 2).
buildingUpgrade.torre_do_vigia: Each level increases defensive attack (level 1: +30; +20 per level).
buildingUpgrade.muralha: Each level increases defensive HP (level 1: +200; +150 per level).

map.title: World Map
map.noArmy: Recruit troops in the city first.
map.marchQueueFull: queues full — wait for a march to finish

battle.title: Tactical Battle
battle.fightHint: Command your troops turn by turn on a hex board.
battle.hint: Click one of your troops, then a green tile to move or a red enemy to attack.
battle.roundLimitNote: Round limit reached — decided by HP; the enemy survived.

tile.cover_desc: A unit standing here takes 33% less damage.
tile.cover_lore: A fold in the veil hardens the air like living stone. Those who shelter in its shadow have blows softened by the very weave of the world.
tile.hazard_desc: Ending your move here deals damage (~10% of HP).
tile.hazard_lore: Here the fabric of reality tears open. To cross the rift is to feel the world drag back whatever dared to step on it.
tile.warp_desc: Halves ranged damage against a unit standing here.
tile.warp_lore: The air bends into unseen spirals. Arrows and projectiles lose their way, deflected by the breath of the veil.

reports.title: Reports
reports.collectBounced: Troops returned without gathering (node occupied or depleted).

node.hint: More troops carry more and drain a small node faster. Filling full load takes the same time.
